diagnosis: The legal agreement status endpoint queries bun:sqlite by agreementId without checking that company_name or signer_email corresponds to the authenticated corporate user. An authenticated corporate user can enumerate agreement IDs to view execution timestamps, signatories, and confidential titles of NDAs signed by competing companies.
exploit_request:
GET /api/legal/agreements/agr_nda_merger_stealth_corp/status HTTP/1.1
Host: legal.corporatesign.io
Authorization: Bearer corp_user_token_bravo
